THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 33
My No.: DIVKE/LND/LND2/ACQUT/5/6. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4-3/8/2014/PC/84.

I, D. P. S. Kumara, Divisional Secretary of the Division of Kuliyapitiya East in Kurunegala District in terms of Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) do hereby give notice that a sum of Rs. One Thousand (Rs. 1000/=) being compensation for the acquisition of the land described in the Schedule below has been deposited in the District Court of Kuliyapitiya under following case numbers to be drawn by the person entitled thereto.
D. P. S. Kumara, Divisional Secretary, Kuliyapitiya East.
22nd January, 2025.
